title: Writing Practice — Handwritten letters — Causes and solutions
description: Academic Task 1 data report and Task 2 essay. Causes and solutions. Suggested time: 60 minutes.

tasks.prompt:
The table shows participants in regular letter-writing activities in four reporting periods during one year.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.

Many young people find it difficult to adapt their tone in formal correspondence.

What are the main causes of this problem, and what measures could help solve it?

Give reasons for your answer and include relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.
